clips.title: The story
paras: Menethil Harbor is a heavily fortified dwarven port town perched on an island off the western shore of the Wetlands. Named after King Terenas Menethil II, it acts as the primary maritime lifeline connecting the Eastern Kingdoms to the distant shores of Kalimdor. Sheltered behind massive stone battlements and the sturdy towers of Menethil Keep, it is a bustling hub for merchants, off-duty soldiers, and salty adventurers.

Named in tribute to King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, Menethil Harbor stands as a premier Alliance haven on the Wetlands coast. Despite its remote marshland setting, it remains a heavily defended bastion, reinforced by massive walls, a single bridged causeway, and the four stone watchtowers of Menethil Keep.
